module.name: library-lending
module.purpose: Let members borrow books for a fixed period, return them, pay a fee when they are late, and reserve books that are out.

objects.name: a-copy-is-on-loan
claims: A copy is on loan to at most one member at a time.

objects.name: a-loan-has-a-due
claims: A loan has a due date 14 days after it starts.

objects.name: a-late-fee-accrues-for
claims: A late fee accrues for each day a loan is overdue and never exceeds the price of the book.

objects.name: a-member-with-unpaid-fees
claims: A member with unpaid fees above the fee limit cannot borrow.

objects.name: a-returned-loan-cannot-be
claims: A returned loan cannot be returned again.

objects.name: a-reservation-is-held-for
claims: A reservation is held for the first member in the queue when a copy is returned.

objects.name: on-time-loan
claims: A member with no fees and an available copy.
The member borrows the copy.
A loan exists with a due date 14 days later and the copy is on loan.

objects.name: late-return
claims: A loan that is 3 days overdue.
The member returns the copy.
The loan is returned and a late fee for 3 days is charged.

objects.name: fee-block
claims: A member whose unpaid fees are above the fee limit.
The member tries to borrow a copy.
The loan is refused.

objects.name: reserved-return
claims: A returned copy with two members waiting in the reservation queue.
The copy is returned.
The copy is held for the first member in the queue.

objects.name: reservation-hold-expiry
claims: What happens when the first member in the queue does not collect a held copy?

objects.name: renewal-with-reservation
claims: May a member renew a loan when another member has reserved the book?

objects.name: lost-book-fee
claims: What is charged when a book is never returned and the late fee cap is reached?

objects.name: hold-expiry
claims: An uncollected hold expires 3 days after the copy is offered.
An expired hold passes to the next member in the queue.

objects.name: renewal-with-reservation
claims: A loan cannot be renewed while the book has a reservation.
